name: labs/mclim9__rssd
title: Rohde & Schwarz FSWP phase noise analyzer (rssd PNA class)
intro: Rohde & Schwarz FSWP phase noise analyzer (rssd PNA class), adapted from mclim9/rssd. It reads `channels`, `sweep_time_s`, `sweep_type` and `reference_level_db`; sets `attenuation_db`, `center_freq_hz` and `sweep_points`. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mclim9__rssd --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mclim9__rssd --backend fake --mcp
